name: Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026
short_description: The Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026 is a full and half marathon race held on November 28, 2026 in Janda Baik, Bentong, Pahang, Malaysia.

faqs.question: When is the Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on November 28, 2026. The event is held in Janda Baik, Bentong, Pahang, Malaysia, and offers both full marathon and half marathon distances for participants planning to take part in this Malaysian race.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026 offers two race distances: a full marathon of 42.195 km, which is the primary distance, and a half marathon of 21.1 km. Both distances are held on the same day, November 28, 2026, at the Janda Baik venue in Bentong, Pahang.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026 is currently open. Runners interested in either the full marathon or half marathon distance can sign up ahead of the race date of November 28, 2026, which will be held in Janda Baik, Bentong, Pahang, Malaysia.

faqs.question: Where is the Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Bentong Monsoon Marathon 2026 is held in Janda Baik, located in Bentong, Pahang, Malaysia. This venue hosts both the full marathon and half marathon distances on November 28, 2026, making it the central location for all race-day activities and participant logistics.
